decisions.reason: Conferencing demand rose during the pandemic, but Teams and Zoom have commoditised it and nothing shows it beating aspirations, so the firm keeps this low-cost add-on while it reviews the portfolio.
Metro data centre connectivity has shown adoption by financial customers and sits at the centre of the firm's high-bandwidth, data-centre-focused strategy, so it exceeds aspirations.
The number ordering portal is a cheap self-service tool that supports real-time voice provisioning and fits the digital direction, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service and a clear pruning candidate, but it runs on existing infrastructure and expansion slack still lets the firm carry it a little longer.
Direct voice network connection is core enterprise voice business with steady relevance as firms migrate to cloud telephony, so its results give no reason to reallocate resources.
